title: ALMA Observation of NGC 5135: The Circumnuclear CO (6-5) and Dust Continuum Emission at 45 pc Resolution
question: What are the properties of the circumnuclear CO (6-5) and 435 um dust emission in NGC 5135, what is the AGN contribution, and what heats the CO (6-5) gas?

data.sensitivity: channel rms ~18 mJy/beam (13.5 km/s); moment-0 rms 1.2 Jy/beam km/s; continuum 2.2 mJy/beam

what.value: Herschel FTS CO(6-5) flux of whole galaxy, 1,617 Jy km/s

evidence.quote: the *Herschel*/FTS observation gives a ${\mathrm{CO}}\,(6\text{--}5)$ flux of 1,617 Jy km s$^{-1}$

what.value: [Fe II]/Br-gamma line ratios from IFU observations

evidence.quote: (cite: 2012ApJ...749..116C) measured the intensity and velocity fields of both the Br-$\gamma$ and the \[Fe ii\] 1.64$\,\mu{\rm m}$ emission lines in the nuclear region of NGC 5135.

what.value: VLA 6 cm radio image used to locate AGN

evidence.quote: The VLA 6 cm radio continuum image of (cite: 1989ApJ...343..659U) has a modest resolution of 0.91$''$ $\times$ 0.60$''$
The intrinsic 2.0-10 keV X-ray luminosity of NGC 5135 is $\sim$1.8 $\times$ 10$^{43}$ erg s$^{-1}$ (cite: 2012MNRAS.419.2089S).

We therefore used the infrared AGN SED for $L_{2.0-10\,\,\rm keV} 
> 10^{42.9}$ erg s$^{-1}$ in (cite: 2011MNRAS.414.1082M)

recipe.method: Clean with Briggs weighting; line from one SPW, continuum from the other three; uv-taper version also made
Moment 0 integrated 3971-4157 km/s; moments 1 and 2 with 4 sigma_ch threshold on uv-tapered image
assumptions: Radio velocity convention nu_obs = nu_rest(1 - V/c)

recipe.method: 3-sigma upper limits at AGN position (radio peak) for CO and continuum; SED comparison
assumptions: AGN emission confined to area smaller than beam

recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fit to clump maps; CLUMPFIND variant for blends; deconvolve beam; extract spectra in elliptical apertures
M_vir = 5 dV^2 R / G; M_mol from 435 um flux via Scoville et al. 2016 and from CO flux with alpha_CO
key_parameters: dV deconvolved with 13.5 km/s channel; 10 km/s rotation removed; flux x1.731 for total

recipe.goal: Compare CO/continuum ratio with [FeII]/Br-gamma and other-wavelength images
recipe.method: Plot R_CO/cont vs [FeII]/Br-gamma for clumps; overlay on PAH, Pa-alpha, HST images
assumptions: HST images aligned by matching adopted AGN position with brightest point

answer_key.quantity: Total CO(6-5) flux of four regions

evidence.quote: The total CO (6-5) flux from the combined four regions in Fig. 1a is 512 $\pm$ 24 Jy km s$^{-1}$.

answer_key.quantity: Total CO(6-5) flux in 0.4" tapered image
435 um continuum flux of four regions

evidence.quote: we derived a total flux of 181 $\pm$ 25 mJy for the 435$\,\mu{\rm m}$ continuum emission

answer_key.quantity: Fraction of Herschel CO(6-5) flux in ALMA regions

evidence.quote: account for $\sim$32% of the total CO (6-5) flux of the galaxy
with the 3-$\sigma$ flux upper limit equal to 5.4 mJy
the radii range from 45 to 180 pc for the clumps
The resulting $\Delta V_{\rm FWHM}$ ranges from 60 to 88  km s$^{-1}$.
the two Category (ii) clumps have $R_{\rm CO/cont} > 4,000$  km s$^{-1}$
